Name: Cute Triceratops Dinosaurs - CP and AT
Author: HeyKatu
Description:
I really loved Identitypollution's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3620]Cuter, Fatter Dinos[/url], but it hasn't been updated since 2018. :( I attempted to get in touch with the author to port it to Stardew 1.6, but I believe they are inactive. So I did what any sane person would do - I redrew the sprites by hand, using their originals as a reference.

I also made some changes: I enhanced the waddle quite a bit, made them a little shorter, and gave them little dots on their butts (where else do the eggs come from???). I recolored them in a BUNCH of colors.

The mod is available as a replacer via Content Patcher, or as an Alternative Textures content pack. You can install both if you like, but in case you want one or the other, they're packaged separately. :)
